settings.text: Three generations of butchers · Smoked over real wood · Product of the USA

settings.cards_text: Beef and pork sourced from U.S. farms. We know where it comes from, and so do you.
Smoked over actual wood — never 'liquid smoke' painted on like a coward. You can taste the difference.
Gluten-free, soy-free, no MSG, no added nitrates. 7g of protein. Clean since day one.

settings.about_heading: "I'm a third-generation butcher. I don't put my name on junk."
settings.about_text:
Ryan grew up behind the counter. His father did too, and his father before that — three generations of people who can tell you exactly where a cut comes from and exactly what belongs in it.

So when Firecreek makes a meat stick, it starts with beef and pork from American farms, gets smoked over real hickory — never liquid smoke brushed on like a shortcut — and ends with a label you can actually read.

settings.line_block_text: The one that started it all. Clean beef & pork, real hickory smoke, nothing you can't pronounce. A handshake in snack form.
A right hook of red pepper and jalapeño. Enough heat to wake you up — not enough to send you crying to the milk carton.
Smoky-sweet up front, a slow ember on the finish. A backyard cookout you can keep in your pocket.
Savory, a little sweet, unapologetically umami. The fancy one — but it'd never brag about it.

settings.section_heading: Try all four for the price of a coffee.
settings.section_text: $7.99, shipping included, one per new household. Find your flavor, then come back for the bag.

settings.testimonial_text: "I grabbed a 20 pack sampler after a friend told me about them and they were way better than I expected. I've had Slim Jim's and other similar snacks in the past, but these were so much better. Kicker and the Sweet Heat BBQ are my favorite, but there really wasn't a flavor I didn't like. Will definitely be ordering more!"

"These meat sticks have been a total game changer when I'm on the go — especially at my kids' ball games or when I need a quick protein boost. They've helped me skip the chips and make better choices that actually support my health and fitness goals. The Kicker is my favorite 🔥 Highly recommend grabbing the sampler to try them all!"

"My family has tried a lot of different brands of meat sticks. These hands down are our favorite! All the flavors are good but our top favorites are original, teriyaki and kicker! We take them everywhere — hikes, sports, or just as a quick snack."

"I got a handful of these wonderful meat sticks at the Lidl grocery nearby, and they are the best I have tasted (I love meat sticks as snacks while riding my motorcycle). I liked them so much, I bought a sample pack and more for a week long ride I am taking, to share with my brother riders."
"Some sticks have a nasty aftertaste. You can tell these are made with legit ingredients. I'm trying to save them to put in snack bags for the team. But, I might eat them all."

"The flavors were so amazing! My favorite part about these Firecreek snacks and what makes them soooo different is they taste so fresh! They are not greasy like other beef sticks. My kids keep asking me for more!"
